integrity.summary: Work stayed inside the run's own application directory. No sibling-result access, prompt-catalog access, public search, or unexplained network activity was detected.
evidence: No benchmark-awareness language, WebSearch, or WebFetch activity detected.
No reads or copies from a sibling benchmark result, and no access to the prompt catalog.
Workflow: 69 file changes, 4 build/test/browser verification actions.

overall.summary: The stronger engine of the pair: a layer-aware spatial hash, adaptive substepping and a full energy budget, wrapped in a wider settings surface. It loses ground on the visual brief, where the car reads as a slab rather than a car.

standards.summary: 1,794 lines with a documented broadphase, speed-derived substepping and an explicit total-energy accumulator. The commentary explains the non-obvious choices instead of narrating the code.
strengths: Spatial hash broadphase that respects depth layers so cross-layer pairs are never tested
Substep count derived from car speed and the smallest brick dimension, which keeps tunnelling out across the full range
System energy computed from linear plus rotational terms rather than approximated
Settings table is a single declarative array, so the panel and the defaults cannot drift apart

specification.summary: All thirteen mandatory defaults are exact and fifteen parameters are exposed, grouped into Test, Wall, Material, Vehicle and World, which is a superset of the five required controls.
strengths: Every mandatory default matches the brief to the digit
Exposes brick friction, restitution, car mass and simulation scale beyond the required five
Wall integrity percentage and displaced-brick count give a comparable outcome metric

ux.summary: Keycap chips on the buttons and a distance ruler are nice touches, but the car fails the explicit visual requirement and the panel has no ARIA at all.

findings.title: Car does not read as a car at rest
findings.detail: The brief asks for a recognizable car with body, cabin and wheels. At the default framing the vehicle renders as a rounded slab with a faint canopy and no visible wheels, so the scene reads as an abstract mass rather than a crash test. Add wheel geometry and a cabin outline that survive the ambient lighting pass.

findings.title: No ARIA anywhere in the document
findings.detail: The document contains zero aria- or role attributes. The settings panel, telemetry region and control bar are all unlabelled for assistive technology. Label the controls and mark the telemetry as a live region.

findings.title: Telemetry shows no pre-impact energy
findings.detail: Kinetic energy reads 0.0 kJ before the run, so the user cannot anticipate how a settings change will affect the outcome. Show the armed kinetic energy from the configured speed and mass.

strengths: Keycap chips inside the buttons teach the shortcuts without a separate legend
Distance ruler anchored at the wall makes displacement readable
Wall-integrity bar gives an at-a-glance outcome
Ambient lighting and headlight bloom make the scene atmospheric
